questions.q: The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded in which city?
questions.exp: The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded in Oslo, Norway. All other Nobel Prizes (Physics, Chemistry, Medicine, Literature, Economics) are awarded in Stockholm, Sweden.

questions.q: Mother Teresa received the Nobel Peace Prize in?
questions.exp: Mother Teresa received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1979 for her work with the poor and destitute in Calcutta (Kolkata), India. She founded the Missionaries of Charity in 1950.

questions.q: The Bharat Ratna is awarded for?
opts: Exceptional service or performance of the highest order
questions.exp: The Bharat Ratna is India's highest civilian award. It is awarded for exceptional service/performance of the highest order, without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex.

questions.q: The first recipient of the Bharat Ratna was?
questions.exp: C. Rajagopalachari (Rajaji) was one of the first recipients of Bharat Ratna in 1954, along with C.V. Raman and S. Radhakrishnan. He was also the first and last Indian Governor-General.

questions.q: The Man Booker Prize is awarded for?
questions.exp: The Booker Prize (formerly Man Booker Prize) is a prestigious literary prize awarded annually for the best original novel written in English and published in the UK or Ireland.

questions.q: The Arjuna Award is given for?
questions.exp: The Arjuna Award is given by the Government of India to recognize outstanding achievement in sports. It was instituted in 1961. Recipients get a statuette of Arjuna, a certificate, and a cash prize.

questions.q: The Oscar Award is officially known as?
questions.exp: The Oscar Award is officially known as the Academy Award of Merit, presented by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS) since 1929.

questions.q: The Pulitzer Prize is awarded in the field of?
questions.exp: The Pulitzer Prize is awarded annually for excellence in journalism, literary achievements, and musical composition in the United States. It was established in 1917.

questions.q: Which Indian won the Nobel Prize in Economics in 2019?
questions.exp: Abhijit Banerjee (along with Esther Duflo and Michael Kremer) won the Nobel Prize in Economics in 2019 for their experimental approach to alleviating global poverty.

questions.q: The Dronacharya Award is given to?
questions.exp: The Dronacharya Award is given by the Government of India to eminent coaches who have successfully trained sportspersons or teams and enabled them to achieve outstanding results in international competitions.
